metadata.geography: Institutions located in Arkansas; graduate earnings are not restricted to Arkansas employment or residence.
metadata.earningsDescription: Median annual earnings four years after completion for federally aided completers working and not enrolled; 2017–18 and 2018–19 completion cohorts, earnings observed in calendar years 2022 and 2023, inflation adjusted to 2024 dollars.
metadata.overallEarningsDescription: Official institution-wide median annual earnings of federally aided undergraduate completers working and not enrolled four years after completion. All fields and undergraduate credentials are pooled; this is not an average of program medians. Completion cohorts 2017–18 and 2018–19, observed in 2022 and 2023, in 2024 dollars.
metadata.overallEarningsAggregation: Official OPEID6-level outcome repeated across associated institution rows; opeidInstitutionIds and opeidStates describe the group. Counts must not be added across branches. Overall outcomes are not credential-specific and exclude graduate credentials and noncompleters.
metadata.predominantCredentialDescription: PREDDEG is the institution's predominant undergraduate award in 2024–25, not the credential of each person in the overall earnings cohort: 0 unclassified, 1 certificate, 2 associate, 3 bachelor, 4 exclusively graduate. Any study duration derived from this classification is a scenario assumption, not an observed completion time.
metadata.highSchoolDescription: Median annual earnings of high-school/GED graduates aged 25–34 with earnings and not enrolled, in the institution's state; wages, salary and self-employment; 2019–2023 ACS pooled, adjusted to 2024 dollars.
metadata.costDescription: Institution-wide undergraduate reference prices in the source academic year's dollars, not program-specific or graduate costs. Net price includes living expenses and subtracts grants; at non-academic-year schools it concerns the largest program and may be a full-program amount when shorter than one year.
metadata.missingValuePolicy: PS/PrivacySuppressed => null + suppressed; NA/NULL/blank => null + unavailable. No substitute earnings timepoint or imputation.
metadata.aggregation: One observation per OPEID6 × four-digit CIP × credential. Identical branch rows are deduplicated, with relatedInstitutionIds retained. OPEID6 earnings may cover multiple branches, including branches outside Arkansas. These are not additive people counts.
limitations: Observed medians are descriptive, not causal effects, lifetime earnings or the arithmetic means in the paper's original shortcut method.
Some program outcomes are suppressed or unavailable; absence is not zero earnings.
Earnings are for federally aided completers, and exclude people not working or still enrolled at measurement.
A high-school benchmark is not a bachelor's-degree counterfactual for graduate study.
Earnings dollars and institution cost reference years differ; current prices should not be described as 2024-dollar observed costs.
Program earnings reflect historical completers and do not establish whether a program currently accepts applicants.
documentationNotes: The October 2026 dictionary's Most_Recent_Inst_Cohort_Map and current glossary identify the high-school threshold as 2023 ACS 5-year pooled; its historical Institution_Cohort_Map instead labels that field 2024 ACS. This build follows the most-recent map and glossary and preserves observed values unchanged.

Overall uses the Scorecard institution file's four-year completer measure, not the separate ten-year entrant measure MD_EARN_WNE_P10, which includes noncompleters. Scorecard values remain in 2024 dollars per its dictionary; the FAFSA lower-earnings indicator separately adjusts these earnings to January 2026 dollars, and those adjusted values are not used here.
